links.outcome: Local ambient scribe assessment of documentation time, clinician-rated accuracy, quality, efficiency, and well-being
links.effect: Median administration time fell from 27 min (manual) to 10 min (AVT) (P<0.001); AVT took 45% of manual time; clinician-rated accuracy, quality and efficiency significantly higher.
links.quote: The median administration time per clinical encounter reduced from 27 min (manual) to 10 min (AVT) (P < 0.001).

screen.reason: Empirical pre-post evaluation of ambient voice AI documentation in an active child and adolescent psychiatry out-patient clinic measuring documentation time and clinician/patient perception, but not evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
